children: California's attorney general and Paramount discussed a series of potential concessions as part of advanced settlement negotiations, including a $1.5 billion investment by the company in domestic production. "The 10-Point: Republicans Pour Cash Into a Midterm Fight Shaped by Voter Discontent - WSJ Newsletter" at 5:57 a.m. ET on Sept. 21 incorrectly said the investment was in production in California.
